qualification: Completed independent cold native campaigns, not a replay or an agent execution by this tool. Every command, public pixel, animation frame, level count and state is compared exactly as recorded, with no normalization. Receipts bind the reports, traces, unchanged native inventories, runner/harness/generator and complete passive journals. Recorded execution files are checked against the retained files; game asset digests are compared without reading game implementations. The whole-trace comparison retains any sourceDigest difference and is not relabeled as strict equality. Full retained proposal objects are also compared strictly, with session observation-reference differences left intact; the required proposal projection separately compares actions and kinds, not every private binding or memory field. The required metadata comparisons omit only the listed timing or implementation fields. Success establishes this public trajectory, selected metadata and execution protocol, not full private graph equivalence, global V5/V6 parity, causal contribution of a new capability or any performance budget.
